continuityPolicy.sceneFrameRule: each scene locks both a start frame and an end frame before video generation
continuityPolicy.continuousHandoffRule: use the prior scene final frame as the next scene start seed when action, pose, camera, props, and location must continue
continuityPolicy.transitionCutRule: use an approved independent next-scene start frame when the edit intentionally changes time, location, angle, scale, or emotional beat; define transition type, duration, purpose, and audio/visual bridge

audioPolicy.timingGuideRule: if issue includes `대본:`, estimate rough narration timing with a local/basic no-paid-API guide TTS or equivalent timing pass before final runtime is locked
